statement: editorial/profiles/transformation/adapt.json defines 'adapt' as a cross-medium modality change (its may_change list, its typical_content_types/typical_surfaces, and schemas/examples/intent-child-explainer.example.json's own basis field all frame it as text-to-audio, text-to-slides, article-to-video). This task's child-audience variant is text-to-text: the medium does not change, only the reader's age-driven complexity ceiling does (vocabulary, concreteness, conceptual step size per audience/child-upper-elementary.json). This intent record resolved transformation to 'adapt' anyway, following the precedent already set by schemas/examples/intent-child-explainer.example.json, which makes the same same-medium choice without commenting on the mismatch. The task worked (must_preserve — uncertainty, thesis — was honored; new_claims:forbidden was honored; no new facts were introduced), so this is not reported as a broken output. It is reported because the axis registry currently gives no clear answer to a straightforward question: is a same-medium, audience-driven complexity change (a) a legitimate broad reading of 'modality' (age-appropriate reading level as a 'modality'), (b) actually the job of 'rewrite' (which explicitly allows 'register, to fit a new surface or audience' and forbids new claims, matching this task's constraints closely) combined with the audience axis doing the complexity work, or (c) a gap that should get its own transformation profile. Both existing precedent (the intake-child-explainer example) and this task chose (a) without the registry ever deciding the question explicitly.

routing.rationale: editorial/feedback-routing.json's intake layer owns cases where 'the artifact axis... was read as a style request' and axis interpretation questions generally; this is the same shape of question one level up the axis stack (transformation, not artifact). Confidence is medium, not high, because the existing example fixture (schemas/examples/intent-child-explainer.example.json) already made the same choice — this may be settled precedent this feedback record simply had not seen documented as a decision, rather than a genuinely open gap. Not routed to 'audience': the audience axis correctly did its own job (child-upper-elementary.json's traits were applied without complaint); the open question is specifically about which transformation id should carry a same-medium complexity change, not about audience-profile content.
